title: What the house still needs
lead: Materials and things that are still missing to rebuild. The table shows an illustrative photo when there is one, how much is left, an estimate per unit and the total still needed. The estimate is not a fixed price: it comes from an internet average. If a store in Formosa charges something else, that is what counts. The photos do not represent the real object. “I want to donate” opens the item: you can bring the same good —with a name and a phone number or an email— or cover it with money, without creating an account. The email opens an account so you can handle it on the site; the phone number asks someone to call you.
seoDescription: What materials and things Norma’s house still needs, and how much remains to be covered.
emptyTitle: No list has been published yet
emptyBody: When the team loads what is still needed, it appears here. In the meantime there are other ways to help.
unavailableTitle: The list is not available right now
reservedPhoto: A photo of {title} will go here, when there is one.
loading: Loading what the house still needs.
noteHint: Optional. It is not published. Useful if the delivery needs coordinating.
appearNamed: I want to appear by name
appearNamedHint: If you leave this unchecked, what you bring is counted without your name. That is the default.
conflictBody: That unit is already reserved under someone else's name. The list was updated.
tableCaption: What is still needed, with an illustrative photo when there is one, how much, an estimate per unit and the total still needed. The estimate is not a fixed price. The photos do not represent the real object. A name appears only if that person chose to be named.
coverLead: You can bring the same good or cover it with money. The amount is an estimate, not a fixed price. It comes from an internet average for a new item of this kind. If a store in Formosa charges something else, that is what counts.
bringLead: Leave your name and a phone number or an email. With the phone number we write to the person who coordinates so they can call you: no account is needed and the item stays reserved in your name until they confirm. With the email an account is created: that is how we confirm the mailbox, and when you come back one click reserves the item.
bringSignedInLead: One click reserves the item and we write to the person who coordinates. How you appear is chosen in your account.
moneyLead: No account and no sign-up. When the bank transfer, Mercado Pago or PayPal payment is made, that is enough. If you want to appear, the name is asked when the team records what arrived, not now.
contactNameHint: So the person who coordinates knows who they are talking to. It is not published.
contactPhoneHint: If you leave it, we write to the person who coordinates so they can call you. It is not published.
contactEmailHint: If you leave it, an account is created so you can handle it on the site. It is not published.
contactChannelHint: A phone number or an email, one of the two. If you fill both, we use the email.
claimPhoneHint: Optional. If you leave it blank, we write to the email on the account.
offerThanksBody: We'll be in touch with you. The item stays reserved in your name until the person who coordinates confirms.
pickupAddressHint: Street, town, a landmark. Without the address nobody can come and get the good. It is not published.
coverNoEstimate: This item has no estimate loaded. If you cover it with money, you choose the amount.
coverNet: By bank transfer or PayPal, the estimate is {amount}. No Mercado Pago fee.
coverMercadoPago: On Mercado Pago the suggested amount is {amount}: the estimate plus a 10% fee. It is an estimate, not a fixed price.
coverExtraHint: Optional. Added on top of the suggested amount. You cannot go below it.
coverTotal: Amount to send via Mercado Pago: {amount}. It is an estimate, not a fixed price. On Mercado Pago you can enter this total or more.
coverPaypal: On PayPal the estimate is {amount}, without the Mercado Pago fee. On PayPal you choose the equivalent: we do not convert currencies here.
